WITH
Treatment_Last AS
(
SELECT
	t.dwh_client_id AS dwh_client_id,
	t.patient_id AS patient_id,
	MIN(t.first_treat) AS first_treat,
	MAX(t.last_treat) AS last_treat,
	MAX(t.last_011) AS last_011,
	MAX(t.last_012) AS last_012,
	MAX(t.last_022) AS last_022,
	MAX(t.last_037) AS last_037,
	SUM(t.debt_items) AS debt_items,
	SUM(t.incomplete) AS incomplete,
	SUM(t.incomplete_active) AS incomplete_active
FROM {{ ref('treat_last') }} t
{% if client_id %}
WHERE t.dwh_client_id = '{{ client_id | replace("'", "\\'") }}'
{% endif %}
GROUP BY
	t.dwh_client_id,
	t.patient_id
),

Categories AS
(
SELECT
	p.dwh_client_id AS dwh_client_id,
	v.Object_ID AS patient_id,
	toInt32( max(coalesce(v.Param_Value,g.Default_Value))) AS pcat_id
FROM {{ source('staging_layer', 'APOC_Parameters_dedup') }} p
LEFT JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'APOC_Object_Groups_Parameters_dedup') }} g ON p.dwh_client_id = g.dwh_client_id AND p.Param_ID = g.Param_ID -- AND p.Param_Code = 'CATEGORY'
JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'APOC_Object_Types_dedup') }} t ON p.dwh_client_id = t.dwh_client_id AND p.Object_Type_ID = t.Object_Type_ID AND t.Object_Type_Code = 'PATIENT'
LEFT JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'APOC_Parameters_Values_dedup') }} v ON p.dwh_client_id = v.dwh_client_id AND p.Param_ID = v.Param_ID AND today() BETWEEN v.Start_Date AND if( v.End_Date = makeDate32(1900, 1, 1) , makeDate32(2299, 12, 31) + 255671,v.End_Date)
WHERE
	p.Param_Code = 'CATEGORY'
{% if client_id %}
	and t.dwh_client_id = '{{ client_id | replace("'", "\\'") }}'
{% endif %}
GROUP BY
	dwh_client_id,
	patient_id
settings join_use_nulls = 1
),

Default_Categories AS
(
SELECT 
	dwh_client_id as dwh_client_id,
	pcat_id as pcat_id
FROM {{ source('staging_layer', 'patients_categories_dedup') }}
WHERE
	is_default = 1
{% if client_id %}
	and dwh_client_id = '{{ client_id | replace("'", "\\'") }}'
{% endif %}
),

Next_Recalls AS
(
SELECT
	dwh_client_id as dwh_client_id,
	patient_id as patient_id,
	min(recall_date) as next_recall_date
FROM {{ source('staging_layer', 'patients_recalls_dedup') }}
WHERE
	recall_date >= today()
{% if client_id %}
	and dwh_client_id = '{{ client_id | replace("'", "\\'") }}'
{% endif %}
GROUP BY
	dwh_client_id,
	patient_id
)

SELECT
	p.dwh_client_id,
	p.patient_id,
	p.family_head_id,
	p.patients_cart_num,
	p.firstname,
	p.surname,
	concat(p.firstname, ' ', p.surname),
	p.dob,
	p.mobile,
	p.email,
	arrayStringConcat(
		groupUniqArray(m.comm_mode),
		', '
	) AS contact_preference,        
	arrayStringConcat(
		groupUniqArray(mc.description),
		', '
	) AS medical_conditions, 
	arrayStringConcat(
		groupUniqArray(at.PATIENTS_ALERT_TYPE),
		', '
	) AS patient_alerts, 
	arrayStringConcat(
		groupUniqArray(al.description),
		', '
	) AS allergies,
	pr.id,
	pr.provider_is_active,
	pr.provider_name,
	pr.provider_profession,
	pr.location_id,
	coalesce(t.debt_items,0),
	t.incomplete,
	t.incomplete_active,
	t.first_treat,
	t.last_treat,
	t.last_011,
	t.last_012,
	t.last_022,
	t.last_037,
	if( p.treatment_completed = '1', 1, 0) AS treatment_completed,
	if( coalesce(pc.is_active,1) = 0, 0, 1) as category_is_active,
	pc.name as category_name,
	if( category_is_active = 1 AND dateDiff('month', last_treat, today() ) < 19, 1, 0) AS is_active,
	post.suburb AS post_suburb,
	post.code AS post_code,
	post.state AS post_state,
	nr.next_recall_date AS next_recall_date
FROM {{ source('staging_layer', 'patients_dedup') }} p
LEFT JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'linked_communications_dedup') }} c ON (p.dwh_client_id = c.dwh_client_id AND p.patient_id = c.patient_id AND c.mailmerge_category_id = 6)
LEFT JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'communication_methods_dedup') }} m ON (c.dwh_client_id = m.dwh_client_id AND c.comm_method_id = m.comm_method_id)
LEFT JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'pat_med_cond_dedup') }} mp ON (p.dwh_client_id = mp.dwh_client_id AND p.patient_id = mp.pat_id)
LEFT JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'med_conditions_dedup') }} mc ON (mp.dwh_client_id = mc.dwh_client_id AND mp.med_cond_id = mc.id)
LEFT JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'PATIENTS_ALERT_dedup') }} pa ON (p.dwh_client_id = pa.dwh_client_id AND p.patient_id = pa.PATIENT_ID)
LEFT JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'PATIENTS_ALERT_TYPES_dedup') }} at ON (pa.dwh_client_id = at.dwh_client_id AND pa.PATIENTS_ALERT_TYPE_ID = at.PATIENTS_ALERT_TYPE_ID)
LEFT JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'pat_allergy_dedup') }} ap ON (p.dwh_client_id = ap.dwh_client_id AND p.patient_id = ap.patient_id)
LEFT JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'allergy_dedup') }} al ON (ap.dwh_client_id = al.dwh_client_id AND ap.allergy_id = al.id)
LEFT JOIN Treatment_Last t ON (p.dwh_client_id = t.dwh_client_id AND p.patient_id = t.patient_id)
LEFT JOIN Categories cat ON p.dwh_client_id = cat.dwh_client_id AND p.patient_id = cat.patient_id
LEFT JOIN Default_Categories dc ON p.dwh_client_id = dc.dwh_client_id
JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'patients_categories_dedup') }} pc ON coalesce(cat.pcat_id,dc.pcat_id,0) = pc.pcat_id
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('providers') }} pr ON p.dwh_client_id = pr.dwh_client_id AND p.provider_id = pr.id
LEFT JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'post_dedup') }} post ON p.dwh_client_id = post.dwh_client_id AND p.post_id_1 = post.id
LEFT JOIN Next_Recalls nr ON p.dwh_client_id = nr.dwh_client_id AND p.patient_id = nr.patient_id
WHERE p.ref_status IS NULL
{% if client_id %}
  and p.dwh_client_id = '{{ client_id | replace("'", "\\'") }}'
{% endif %}
GROUP BY
	p.dwh_client_id,
	p.patient_id,
	p.family_head_id,
	p.patients_cart_num,
	p.firstname,
	p.surname,
	p.dob,
	p.mobile,
	p.email, 
	pr.id,
	pr.provider_is_active,
	pr.provider_name,
	pr.provider_profession,
	pr.location_id,
	t.debt_items,	
	t.incomplete,
	t.incomplete_active,
	t.first_treat,
	t.last_treat,
	t.last_011,
	t.last_012,
	t.last_022,
	t.last_037,
	p.treatment_completed,
	pc.is_active,
	pc.name,
	post.suburb,
	post.code,
	post.state,
	nr.next_recall_date
settings join_use_nulls = 1

SELECT
	i.dwh_client_id AS dwh_client_id,
	i.practice_id AS location_id,
	i.id AS invoice_id,
	i.date_created AS date,
	coalesce(i.is_surcharge,0) AS invoice_type,
	i.ref_status AS ref_status,
	IF (left(PPA_status,1) = '0', date, coalesce(toDate32(i.when_created),i.date_created_2,date)) AS date_effective,
	toDate32(i.when_deleted) AS date_reversed,
	coalesce(i.lock_date_creation,makeDate32(1900,1,1)) AS lock_date_creation,
	coalesce(i.lock_date_deletion,makeDate32(1900,1,1)) AS lock_date_deletion,
	-- Payment PPA status
	CASE
		WHEN gs.param_value <> '1' THEN '00' 
		WHEN ref_status IS NULL AND lock_date_creation < date THEN '00'
		WHEN ref_status IS NULL THEN '10'
		WHEN lock_date_creation >= date AND lock_date_deletion >= date THEN '11'
		WHEN lock_date_deletion >= date THEN '01'
		ELSE '00'
	END AS PPA_status,
	i.total AS total,
	i.amount_paid AS amount_paid,
	if( coalesce(i.is_bad_debt,'0') = '0', 0, 1 ) AS is_bad_debt,
	i.number_of_instalments AS number_of_instalments,
	i.doctors_list AS doctors_list
FROM 
	{{ source('staging_layer', 'patients_accounts_dedup') }} i
	JOIN {{ ref('general_settings') }} gs ON i.dwh_client_id = gs.dwh_client_id AND gs.param_code = '@ADJUSTMENTS_USED'
WHERE
  least(date,date_effective,date_reversed) < today()
  AND (gs.param_value = '1' OR i.ref_status IS NULL)
  AND (i.ref_status IS NULL OR PPA_status <> '00')

WITH
Collections AS
(
SELECT
	dwh_client_id,
	location_payment AS location_id,
	date_effective AS date,
	method_name as method_name,
	method_show_in_report as method_show_in_report,
	sum( if( payment_type = 0, abs(amount_payment),0) ) AS collected,

	sum( if( payment_type = 4, abs(amount_payment),0) ) AS refunded_for_treatment,
	sum( if( payment_type = 3, abs(amount_payment),0) ) AS bounced,
	cast(0 AS Decimal(18,2)) AS reversed

{% if client_id %}

	location_payment AS location_id,
	date_reversed AS date,
	method_name,
	method_show_in_report,
	cast(0 AS Decimal(18,2)) AS collected,
	sum( if( payment_type = 2, -abs(amount_payment),0) ) AS refunded_from_deposits,
	sum( if( payment_type = 4, -abs(amount_payment),0) ) AS refunded_for_treatment,
	sum( if( payment_type = 3, -abs(amount_payment),0) ) AS bounced,
	sum( if( payment_type = 0, abs(amount_payment),0) ) AS reversed
FROM {{ ref('transactions') }}

  END AS cancel_type_loc,
 	if( dateDiff('day', coalesce(a.date_of_cancellation,a.appointment_date), na.date_of_creation ) between 0 and 21,'Rebooked', 'No rebooking') AS rebooked,
	if( dateDiff('day', coalesce(a.date_of_cancellation,a.appointment_date), nal.date_of_creation ) between 0 and 21,'Rebooked', 'No rebooking') AS rebooked_loc,
  CASE
    WHEN last_012 IS NULL THEN 'No recorded exam'
    WHEN dateDiff('month', last_012, appt_date) > 6 THEN 'Periodic exam due'
    ELSE formatDateTime(addMonths(last_012, 6), '%d/%m/%Y')
  END AS pt_due_periodic_exam,
  CASE
    WHEN last_022 IS NULL THEN 'No recorded xray'
    WHEN dateDiff('month', last_022, appt_date) > 24 THEN 'Xray due'
    ELSE formatDateTime(addMonths(last_022, 24), '%d/%m/%Y')
  END AS pt_due_xray,
  CASE
    WHEN last_037 IS NULL THEN 'No recorded OPG'
    WHEN dateDiff('month', last_037, appt_date) > 60 THEN 'OPG due'
    ELSE formatDateTime(addMonths(last_037, 60), '%d/%m/%Y')
  END AS pt_due_opg,
  f.not_failed AS not_failed,
  f.not_failed_loc AS not_failed_loc,
  fl.not_failed AS not_loc_failed,
  fl.not_failed_loc AS not_loc_failed_loc,
  f.cancels AS cancels,
  fl.cancels AS cancels_loc
FROM Appointments a
JOIN Patients_Booked p ON a.dwh_client_id = p.dwh_client_id AND a.patient_id = p.patient_id
LEFT JOIN Future_Appointments n 
       ON a.dwh_client_id = n.dwh_client_id AND p.patient_id = n.patient_id AND p.patient_id = n.family_member_id AND a.appointment_date = n.appointment_date
LEFT JOIN Appointments na
       ON n.dwh_client_id = na.dwh_client_id AND n.next_appoint_id = na.appoint_id
LEFT JOIN Future_Appointments_Loc nl
       ON a.dwh_client_id = nl.dwh_client_id AND a.location_id = nl.location_id AND p.patient_id = nl.patient_id AND p.patient_id = nl.family_member_id AND a.appointment_date = nl.appointment_date
LEFT JOIN Appointments nal
       ON nl.dwh_client_id = nal.dwh_client_id AND nl.next_appoint_id = nal.appoint_id
LEFT JOIN Appointments_Failed f ON a.dwh_client_id = f.dwh_client_id AND a.patient_id = f.patient_id AND a.appointment_date = f.appointment_date
LEFT JOIN Appointments_Failed_Loc fl ON a.dwh_client_id = fl.dwh_client_id AND a.location_id = fl.location_id AND a.patient_id = fl.patient_id AND a.appointment_date = fl.appointment_date
LEFT JOIN No_Future_Appointments m ON a.dwh_client_id = m.dwh_client_id AND a.patient_id = m.patient_id AND a.appointment_date = m.appointment_date
LEFT JOIN No_Future_Appointments_Loc ml ON a.dwh_client_id = ml.dwh_client_id AND a.location_id = ml.location_id AND a.patient_id = ml.patient_id AND a.appointment_date = ml.appointment_date

  t.provider_profession_id AS provider_profession_id,

  sum(t.qty) AS items_done,
  sum( IF ( t.invoice_type = 0 AND t.non_treat = 0 AND t.non_reporting = 0, t.qty, 0) ) AS items_treat_done,
  cast( 0 AS Int32) AS items_invoices,
  cast( 0 AS UInt16) AS items_plan_invoices,
  cast( 0 AS UInt16) AS items_treat_invoices,
  cast( 0 AS UInt16) AS items_surcharges,
  cast( 0 AS UInt16) AS items_promotions,
  cast( 0 AS UInt16) AS items_discounts,
  cast( 0 AS UInt16) AS items_refunds,
  cast( 0 AS UInt16) AS items_reversals,
  cast( 0 AS UInt16) AS items_net,
  sum( t.fee * t.qty ) AS amount_done,
  sum( IF ( t.invoice_type = 0 AND t.non_treat = 0 AND t.non_reporting = 0, (t.fee * t.qty) + t.promotion, 0) ) AS amount_treat_done,
  cast( 0 AS Decimal(18,2)) AS amount_invoices,
  cast( 0 AS Decimal(18,2)) AS amount_plan_invoices,
  cast( 0 AS Decimal(18,2)) AS amount_treat_invoices,
  cast( 0 AS Decimal(18,2)) AS amount_surcharges,
  cast( 0 AS Decimal(18,2)) AS amount_promotions,
  cast( 0 AS Decimal(18,2)) AS amount_discounts,
  cast( 0 AS Decimal(18,2)) AS amount_refunds,
  cast( 0 AS Decimal(18,2)) AS amount_reversals,
  cast( 0 AS Decimal(18,2)) AS amount_net
FROM {{ ref('treat') }} t
-- All (not lab) items done, except Refunds
WHERE
  t.treat_date < today()
  AND t.invoice_type <> 4
{% if client_id %}
  AND t.dwh_client_id = '{{ client_id | replace("'", "\\'") }}'
{% endif %}
GROUP BY
  dwh_client_id,
  location_id,
  transaction_date,
  item_code,
  item_category,
  item_subcategory,
  provider_id,
  provider_is_active,
  provider_name,
  provider_profession_id,
  provider_profession

UNION ALL
-- Net
SELECT 
  t.dwh_client_id AS dwh_client_id,
  --IF ( gs.param_code = 'PROVIDER', t.provider_location_id, t.invoice_location_id)  AS location_id,
  t.provider_location_id AS location_id,
  t.invoice_date AS transaction_date,

  t.provider_profession_id AS provider_profession_id,
  t.provider_profession AS provider_profession,
  cast( 0 AS UInt16) AS items_done,
  cast( 0 AS UInt16) AS items_treat_done,
  cast(sum(IF( t.treat_date IS NULL, t.plan_qty, t.qty)) AS UInt16) AS items_invoices,
  cast(sum( if( t.invoice_type = 4 OR t.treat_date IS NOT NULL, 0, t.plan_qty ) ) AS UInt16) AS items_plan_invoices,
  cast(sum( if( t.invoice_type = 0 AND t.treat_date IS NOT NULL AND t.non_reporting = 0 AND t.non_treat = 0, t.qty, 0 ) ) AS UInt16) AS items_treat_invoices,
  cast(sum( if( t.invoice_type = 1, t.qty,0) ) AS UInt16) AS items_surcharges,
  cast(sum( if( t.promotion <> 0, t.qty,0) ) AS UInt16) AS items_promotions,
  cast( 0 AS UInt16) AS items_discounts,
  cast(sum( if( t.invoice_type = 4, t.qty,0) ) AS UInt16) AS items_refunds,
  cast( 0 AS UInt16) AS items_reversals,
  items_invoices - items_refunds AS items_net,
  cast( 0 AS Decimal(18,2)) AS amount_done,
  cast( 0 AS Decimal(18,2)) AS amount_treat_done,
  sum( if( t.invoice_type = 4, 0, IF( t.treat_date IS NULL, t.plan_fee * t.plan_qty, t.fee * t.qty) + t.promotion ) ) AS amount_invoices,
  sum( if( t.invoice_type = 4 OR t.treat_date IS NOT NULL, 0, (t.plan_fee * t.plan_qty) + t.promotion ) ) AS amount_plan_invoices,
  sum( if( t.invoice_type = 0 AND t.treat_date IS NOT NULL AND t.non_reporting = 0 AND t.non_treat = 0, (t.fee * t.qty) + t.promotion, 0 ) ) AS amount_treat_invoices,
  sum( if( t.invoice_type = 1, IF( t.treat_date IS NULL, t.plan_fee * t.plan_qty, t.fee * t.qty),0) ) AS amount_surcharges,
  sum( t.promotion ) AS amount_promotions,
  cast( 0 AS Decimal(18,2)) AS amount_discounts,
  sum( if( t.invoice_type = 4, -1 * IF( t.treat_date IS NULL, t.plan_fee * t.plan_qty, t.fee * t.qty),0) ) AS amount_refunds,
  cast( 0 AS Decimal(18,2)) AS amount_reversals,
  amount_invoices - amount_refunds AS amount_net
FROM {{ ref('treat') }} t
JOIN {{ ref('general_settings') }} gs ON t.dwh_client_id = gs.dwh_client_id AND gs.param_code = '@NET_LOCATION'
WHERE
  t.invoice_date < today()
{% if client_id %}
  AND t.dwh_client_id = '{{ client_id | replace("'", "\\'") }}'
{% endif %}
GROUP BY
  dwh_client_id,
  location_id,
  transaction_date,
  item_code,
  item_category,

  provider_id,
  provider_is_active,
  provider_name,

  provider_profession

  cast(count( DISTINCT t.treat_id )AS UInt16) AS items_discounts,
  cast( 0 AS UInt16) AS items_refunds,
  cast( 0 AS UInt16) AS items_reversals,
  items_invoices - items_refunds AS items_net,
  cast( 0 AS Decimal(18,2)) AS amount_done,
  cast( 0 AS Decimal(18,2)) AS amount_treat_done,
  cast( 0 AS Decimal(18,2)) AS amount_invoices,
  cast( 0 AS Decimal(18,2)) AS amount_plan_invoices,

  cast( 0 AS Decimal(18,2)) AS amount_surcharges,

  cast( 0 AS Decimal(18,2)) AS amount_refunds,

FROM {{ ref('treat') }} t

JOIN {{ ref('general_settings') }} gs ON t.dwh_client_id = gs.dwh_client_id AND gs.param_code = '@NET_LOCATION'

WITH

  sum( p.amount ) AS items_amount,
	arrayStringConcat(
		groupUniqArray(concat(pat.name,' (',pat.card,')')),
		', '
	)	 AS treated_patients
FROM {{ ref('invoices') }} i
JOIN {{ ref('treat') }} t
  ON i.dwh_client_id = t.dwh_client_id
  AND t.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
JOIN {{ ref('patients') }} pat
  ON t.dwh_client_id = pat.dwh_client_id
  AND t.patient_id = pat.patient_id
JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'account_payment_plan_dedup') }} pp
	ON t.dwh_client_id = pp.dwh_client_id
  AND t.invoice_id = pp.patient_account_id
  AND pp.ref_status IS NULL
JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'account_payment_plan_items_dedup') }} p
	ON t.dwh_client_id = p.dwh_client_id
  AND t.treat_id = p.treat_id
  AND pp.account_payment_plan_id = p.account_payment_plan_id
  AND p.amount > 0
WHERE
  i.ref_status is NULL

  AND i.date < today()

,

SELECT
	i.dwh_client_id AS dwh_client_id,
	i.invoice_id as invoice_id,
	i.invoice_location_id as invoice_location_id,
	i.invoice_date as invoice_date,
	i.invoice_total as invoice_total,
	i.invoice_amount_paid as invoice_amount_paid,
	i.number_of_instalments as number_of_instalments,
	coalesce(i.is_bad_debt,0) as is_bad_debt,
	i.account_payment_plan_id AS instalment_id,

	i.provider_location_id as provider_location_id,
	i.provider_is_active as provider_is_active,
	i.provider_name as provider_name,
	i.provider_profession as provider_profession,
	i.items_amount as provider_part,
	coalesce(p.paid,0) as provider_part_paid,
	provider_part - provider_part_paid as provider_amount_due,
	i.treated_patients as treated_patients,
  CASE
    WHEN i.resp_third_party_id IS NULL THEN 'Patient'
    WHEN t.thp_type = 0 THEN 'Third party'
    WHEN t.thp_type = 1 THEN 'Insurance'
    WHEN t.thp_type = 12 THEN 'Guardian'
    ELSE 'Unknown type ' || toString(t.thp_type)
  END AS resp_party_type,
	if( i.resp_third_party_id IS NULL, concat(pat.name, ' (', pat.card, ')'), t.name) AS resp_party_name,
  pat.patient_id				AS patient_id,
  pat.card					AS patient_card,

  AND i.resp_patient_id = pat.patient_id
WHERE provider_part > provider_part_paid
GROUP BY
	i.dwh_client_id,
	i.invoice_id,
	i.invoice_location_id,
	i.invoice_date,
	i.invoice_total,
	i.invoice_amount_paid,

	i.provider_location_id,
	i.provider_is_active,
	i.provider_name,

WITH 
Net AS 
(
SELECT
	n.dwh_client_id AS dwh_client_id,
	n.location_id AS location_id,
	n.transaction_date AS date,
	n.provider_id AS provider_id,
	n.provider_is_active AS provider_is_active,
	n.provider_name AS provider_name,
	n.provider_profession_id AS provider_profession_id,
	n.provider_profession AS provider_profession,
	sum(n.amount_done) AS production_gross_amount,
	sum(n.amount_treat_done) AS production_treat_amount,
	sum(n.items_done) AS production_gross_items,
	sum(n.items_treat_done) AS production_treat_items,
	sum(n.amount_invoices) AS amount_invoices,
	sum(n.amount_surcharges) AS amount_surcharges,
	sum(n.amount_promotions) AS amount_promotions,
	sum(n.amount_discounts) AS amount_discounts,
	sum(n.amount_refunds) AS amount_refunds,
	sum(n.amount_reversals) AS amount_reversals,
	sum(n.amount_net) AS net,
	sum(n.items_net) AS treatments
FROM {{ ref('gross_net_details') }} n
{% if client_id %}
WHERE n.dwh_client_id = '{{ client_id | replace("'", "\\'") }}'
{% endif %}
GROUP BY
	n.transaction_date,
	n.dwh_client_id,
	n.location_id,
	n.provider_id,
	n.provider_name,
	n.provider_is_active,
	n.provider_profession_id,
	n.provider_profession
),

Net_Work AS
(
SELECT 
	coalesce(n.dwh_client_id, w.dwh_client_id) AS dwh_client_id,
	coalesce(n.location_id, w.location_id) AS location_id,
	coalesce(n.date, w.date) AS date,
	coalesce(n.provider_id, w.provider_id) AS provider_id,
	coalesce(n.provider_name, w.provider_name) AS provider_name,
	coalesce(n.provider_is_active, w.provider_is_active) AS provider_is_active,
	coalesce(n.provider_profession_id, w.provider_profession_id) AS provider_profession_id,
	coalesce(n.provider_profession, w.provider_profession) AS provider_profession,
	n.production_gross_amount AS production_gross_amount,
	n.production_treat_amount AS production_treat_amount,
	n.production_gross_items AS production_gross_items,
	n.production_treat_items AS production_treat_items,
	n.amount_invoices AS amount_invoices,
	n.amount_surcharges AS amount_surcharges,
	n.amount_promotions AS amount_promotions,
	n.amount_discounts AS amount_discounts,
	n.amount_refunds AS amount_refunds,
	n.amount_reversals AS amount_reversals,
	n.net AS net,
	n.treatments AS treatments,
	sum(w.appointments) AS appointments,
	sum(w.appt_duration) AS work_minutes,
	sum( if( w.appt_type_hidden = 0, w.appointments, 0 ) ) AS appointments_visible,
	sum( if( w.appt_type_hidden = 0, w.appt_duration, 0 ) ) AS work_minutes_visible,
	sum(w.appointments_completed) AS appointments_completed,
	sum(w.appt_duration_completed) AS work_minutes_completed,
	sum( if( w.appt_type_hidden = 0, w.appointments_completed, 0 ) ) AS appointments_visible_completed,
	sum( if( w.appt_type_hidden = 0, w.appt_duration_completed, 0 ) ) AS work_minutes_visible_completed,
	sum(w.appointments_rebooked) AS appointments_rebooked,
	sum(w.appointments_completed_rebooked) AS appointments_completed_rebooked,
	sum(if( w.appt_type_hidden = 0, w.appointments_rebooked, 0 ) ) AS appointments_visible_rebooked,
	sum(if( w.appt_type_hidden = 0, w.appointments_completed_rebooked, 0 )) AS appointments_visible_completed_rebooked
FROM Net n
FULL OUTER JOIN {{ ref('work_minutes') }} w
  ON n.dwh_client_id = w.dwh_client_id
  AND n.location_id = w.location_id
  AND n.provider_id = w.provider_id
  AND n.date = w.date
{% if client_id %}
WHERE w.dwh_client_id = '{{ client_id | replace("'", "\\'") }}'
{% endif %}
GROUP BY
	dwh_client_id,
	location_id,
	date,
	provider_id,
	provider_name,
	provider_is_active,
	provider_profession_id,
	provider_profession,
	production_gross_amount,
	production_treat_amount,
	production_gross_items,
	production_treat_items,
	amount_invoices,
	amount_surcharges,
	amount_promotions,
	amount_discounts,
	amount_refunds,
	amount_reversals,
	net,
	treatments
settings join_use_nulls = 1
),

Target_Plans AS
(
SELECT
	coalesce(n.dwh_client_id, t.dwh_client_id) AS dwh_client_id,
	coalesce(n.provider_location_id, t.location_id) AS location_id,
	coalesce(n.plan_date, t.date) AS date,
	coalesce(n.provider_id, t.provider_id) AS provider_id,
	p.provider_is_active AS provider_is_active,
	p.provider_name AS provider_name,
	p.provider_profession_id AS provider_profession_id,
	p.provider_profession AS provider_profession,
	coalesce(t.target,0) AS target,
	coalesce(t.target_work_minutes,0) AS target_work_minutes,
	sum( n.plan_fee * n.plan_qty ) AS treat_plans_value,
	sum( if( n.charting_is_active = 'Y', n.plan_fee * n.plan_qty, 0 ) ) AS treat_plans_value_active
FROM {{ ref('treat') }} n
FULL OUTER JOIN {{ ref('providers_production_target_days') }} t
  ON n.dwh_client_id = t.dwh_client_id
  AND n.provider_location_id = t.location_id
  AND n.provider_id = t.provider_id
  AND n.plan_date = t.date
JOIN {{ ref('providers') }} p
  ON provider_id = p.id
  AND dwh_client_id = p.dwh_client_id
WHERE
  date < today()
{% if client_id %}
  AND n.dwh_client_id = '{{ client_id | replace("'", "\\'") }}'
  AND t.dwh_client_id = '{{ client_id | replace("'", "\\'") }}'
{% endif %}
GROUP BY
  dwh_client_id,
  location_id,
  date,
  provider_id,
  provider_is_active,
  provider_name,
  provider_profession_id,
  provider_profession,
  target,
  target_work_minutes
settings join_use_nulls = 1
)

SELECT

	coalesce(n.location_id, t.location_id) AS location_id,
	coalesce(n.date, t.date) AS date,

	n.amount_invoices AS amount_invoices,
	n.amount_surcharges AS amount_surcharges,
	n.amount_promotions AS amount_promotions,
	n.amount_discounts AS amount_discounts,
	n.amount_refunds AS amount_refunds,
	n.amount_reversals AS amount_reversals,
	n.net AS net,
	n.treatments AS treatments,
	n.appointments AS appointments,
	n.work_minutes AS work_minutes,
	n.appointments_visible AS appointments_visible,
	n.work_minutes_visible AS work_minutes_visible,
	n.appointments_completed AS appointments_completed,
	n.work_minutes_completed AS work_minutes_completed,

	coalesce(t.target,0) AS target,

WITH
Of_Statuses AS
(
SELECT
o.dwh_client_id AS dwh_client_id,
o.code AS code,
s.Column_Type_Status_Abbreviatio AS value
FROM {{ source('staging_layer', 'a_official_status_dedup') }} o
JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'a_slot_column_status_types_dedup') }} s
	ON o.dwh_client_id = s.dwh_client_id
	AND o.id_status = s.Column_Type_Status_ID
{% if client_id %}
WHERE o.dwh_client_id = '{{ client_id | replace("'", "\\'") }}'
{% endif %}
),
Appt_Statuses AS
(
SELECT
	o.dwh_client_id AS dwh_client_id,
    arrayStringConcat(
        groupUniqArray(if(o.code='UTA',value,'')),
        ''
    ) AS uta,
    arrayStringConcat(
        groupUniqArray(if(o.code='FTA',value,'')),
        ''
    ) AS fta,
    arrayStringConcat(
        groupUniqArray(if(o.code='CANCEL',value,'')),
        ''
    ) AS cancel,
    arrayStringConcat(
        groupUniqArray(if(o.code='CONF',value,'')),
        ''
    ) AS conf,
    arrayStringConcat(
        groupUniqArray(if(o.code='APPCONF',value,'')),
        ''
    ) AS appconf,
    arrayStringConcat(
        groupUniqArray(if(o.code='ARRIVED',value,'')),
        ''
    ) AS arrived
 FROM Of_Statuses o
GROUP BY dwh_client_id
),

Production_Loc AS
(
SELECT
	p.dwh_client_id AS dwh_client_id,
	p.provider_location_id AS location_id,
	p.treat_date AS treat_date,
	p.patient_id AS patient_id,
	sum( p.items ) AS items_done,
	sum( p.treat_items ) AS items_treat_done,
	sum( p.items_012 ) AS items_done_012,
	sum( p.gross ) AS production,
	count( DISTINCT p.provider_id ) AS treat_providers_count,
	arrayStringConcat(arraySort(groupUniqArray(p.provider_id)),',') AS treat_providers_ids
FROM {{ ref('production') }} p
{% if client_id %}
WHERE p.dwh_client_id = '{{ client_id | replace("'", "\\'") }}'
{% endif %}
GROUP BY
	dwh_client_id,
	location_id,
	treat_date,
	patient_id
),

Production AS 
(
SELECT
	p.dwh_client_id AS dwh_client_id,
	p.treat_date AS treat_date,
	p.patient_id AS patient_id,
	sum( p.items_done ) AS items_done,
	sum( p.items_treat_done ) AS items_treat_done,
	sum( p.items_done_012 ) AS items_done_012,
	sum( p.production ) AS production
FROM Production_Loc p
GROUP BY
	dwh_client_id,
	treat_date,
	patient_id
),
Books AS
(
SELECT
	b.dwh_client_id			AS dwh_client_id,
	b.practice_id			AS location_id,
	b.app_book_number		AS appt_book_id,
	b.app_book_description	AS appt_book_name,
	if(b.is_active=1,'Active','Inactive')	AS book_is_active,
	count(DISTINCT IF (s.appointment_book_id IS NULL, NULL,s.member_id ) ) AS book_providers,
	min(s.member_id) 		AS book_provider_id,
	min(s.practice_id)		AS book_provider_location_id
FROM {{ source('staging_layer', 'app_books_dedup') }} b
LEFT JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'staff_dedup') }} s ON b.dwh_client_id = s.dwh_client_id AND b.app_book_number = s.appointment_book_id
{% if client_id %}
WHERE b.dwh_client_id = '{{ client_id | replace("'", "\\'") }}'
{% endif %}
GROUP BY
	dwh_client_id,
	location_id,
	appt_book_id,
	appt_book_name,
	book_is_active
settings join_use_nulls = 1
),
Events AS
(
SELECT
	dwh_client_id as dwh_client_id,
	appoint_id as appoint_id,
	max(arrived_time) as arrived_time,
	max(checkin_time) as checkin_time,
	max(checkout_time) as checkout_time
FROM {{ source('staging_layer', 'patient_event_time_dedup') }}
{% if client_id %}
WHERE dwh_client_id = '{{ client_id | replace("'", "\\'") }}'
{% endif %}
GROUP BY
	dwh_client_id,
	appoint_id
)

SELECT
	a.dwh_client_id				AS dwh_client_id,
	b.location_id				AS location_id,
	b.appt_book_id				AS appt_book_id,
	b.appt_book_name			AS appt_book_name,
	b.book_is_active			AS book_is_active,
	a.appoint_id				AS appoint_id,
	max(a.date_of_creation)		AS date_of_creation,
	a.pat_id					AS patient_id,
	a.doct_id					AS provider_id,
	m.practice_id				AS provider_location_id,
	toDate32(a.app_date)		AS app_date,
	sum(a.duration)				AS duration,
	min(a.start)				AS start,
	d.mm_set					AS recall_set_id,
	r.mailmerge_set_name		AS recall_set_name,
	max(a.class_id)				AS max_class_id,
	max(p.class_description)	AS max_class_description,
	0 AS class_hidden,
	if( s.uta > '', if( countSubstrings(a.status,s.uta) > 0, 1, 0 ) , 0) AS of_status_uta,
	if( s.fta > '', if( countSubstrings(a.status,s.fta) > 0, 1, 0 ) , 0) AS of_status_fta,
	if( s.cancel > '', if( countSubstrings(a.status,s.cancel) > 0, 1, 0 ) , 0) AS of_status_cancel,
	if( s.conf > '', if( countSubstrings(a.status,s.conf) > 0, 1, 0 ) , 0) AS of_status_conf,
	if( s.appconf > '', if( countSubstrings(a.status,s.appconf) > 0, 1, 0 ) , 0) AS of_status_appconf,
	if( s.arrived > '', if( countSubstrings(a.status,s.arrived) > 0, 1, 0 ) , 0) AS of_status_arrived,
	e.arrived_time AS arrived_time,
	e.checkin_time AS checkin_time,
	e.checkout_time AS checkout_time,
	coalesce( pr.items_done, 0) AS items_done,
	coalesce( pr.items_treat_done, 0) AS items_treat_done,
	coalesce( prl.items_done, 0) AS items_done_loc,
	coalesce( prl.items_treat_done, 0) AS items_treat_done_loc,
	coalesce( pr.production,0) AS production,
	coalesce( prl.production,0) AS production_loc,
	prl.treat_providers_count AS treat_providers_count,
	prl.treat_providers_ids AS treat_providers_ids,
	if( b.book_providers = 1, b.book_provider_id, null ) AS book_provider_id,
	if( b.book_providers = 1, b.book_provider_location_id, null ) AS book_provider_location_id,
	coalesce( pr.items_done_012, 0) AS items_done_012,
	coalesce( prl.items_done_012, 0) AS items_done_012_loc,
	max(a.ts_4_update) AS ts_4_update
FROM {{ source('staging_layer', 'a_appointments_dedup') }} a
JOIN Appt_Statuses s ON a.dwh_client_id = s.dwh_client_id
JOIN Books b ON a.dwh_client_id=b.dwh_client_id AND a.app_book_id=b.appt_book_id
JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'appt_dedup') }} d ON a.dwh_client_id=d.dwh_client_id AND a.appt_id=d.id
LEFT JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'mailmerge_sets_dedup') }} r ON d.dwh_client_id=r.dwh_client_id AND d.mm_set=r.mailmerge_set_id
LEFT JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'a_classes_procedures_dedup') }} p ON a.dwh_client_id=p.dwh_client_id AND a.class_id=p.class_id
LEFT JOIN Production pr ON a.dwh_client_id=pr.dwh_client_id AND a.pat_id=pr.patient_id AND a.app_date = pr.treat_date
LEFT JOIN Production_Loc prl ON a.dwh_client_id=prl.dwh_client_id AND b.location_id=prl.location_id AND a.pat_id=prl.patient_id AND a.app_date=prl.treat_date
LEFT JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'staff_dedup') }} m ON (a.doct_id = m.member_id AND a.dwh_client_id = m.dwh_client_id)
LEFT JOIN Events e ON a.dwh_client_id = e.dwh_client_id AND a.appoint_id = e.appoint_id 
WHERE a.pat_id IS NOT NULL
{% if client_id %}
  and a.dwh_client_id = '{{ client_id | replace("'", "\\'") }}'
{% endif %}
GROUP BY 
	dwh_client_id,
	location_id,
	appt_book_id,
	appt_book_name,
	book_is_active,
	appoint_id,
	patient_id,
	provider_id,
	provider_location_id,
	app_date,
	recall_set_id,
	recall_set_name,
	of_status_uta,
	of_status_fta,
	of_status_cancel,
	of_status_conf,
	of_status_appconf,
	of_status_arrived,
	arrived_time,
	checkin_time,
	checkout_time,
	items_done,
	items_treat_done,
	items_done_loc,
	items_treat_done_loc,
	production,
	production_loc,
	treat_providers_count,
	treat_providers_ids,
	book_provider_id,
	book_provider_location_id,
	items_done_012,
	items_done_012_loc
settings join_use_nulls = 1

WITH

Next_Appointments AS
(
SELECT
	dwh_client_id as dwh_client_id,
	patient_id as patient_id,
	min( date_next ) as next_appointment,
	argMin( class_next, date_next ) as next_appointment_type,
	max( date_prev ) as date_prev,
	max( date_prev_attended ) as date_prev_attended,
	max( date_prev_attended_loc ) as date_prev_attended_loc
FROM {{ ref('patients_prev_next_appointment') }}
{% if client_id %}

GROUP BY 
	dwh_client_id,

SELECT
	l.dwh_client_id AS dwh_client_id,
	l.location_id AS location_id,
	p.patient_id AS patient_id,
	p.card AS patient_card,
	p.name AS patient_name,
	p.dob AS patient_dob,
	p.mobile AS patient_mobile,
	p.email AS patient_email,
	p.contact_preference AS patient_contact_preference,

	p.provider_is_active AS provider_is_active,
	p.provider_profession AS provider_profession,
	p.provider_id as provider_id,
	p.provider_location_id as provider_location_id,
	p.last_011 AS last_011,
	max(IF ( t.location_id = l.location_id, t.last_011, NULL)) AS last_011_loc,
	max(IF ( t.last_011 = p.last_011, t.location_id, NULL)) AS loc_last_011,
	p.last_012 AS last_012,
	max(IF ( t.location_id = l.location_id, t.last_012, NULL)) AS last_012_loc,
	max(IF ( t.last_012 = p.last_012, t.location_id, NULL)) AS loc_last_012,
	p.last_treat AS last_treat,
	max(IF ( t.location_id = l.location_id, t.last_treat, NULL)) AS last_treat_loc,
	max(IF ( t.last_treat = p.last_treat, t.location_id, NULL)) AS loc_last_treat,
	na.next_appointment AS next_appointment,
	min(IF ( a.location_id = l.location_id, a.date_next, NULL)) AS next_appointment_loc,
	na.next_appointment_type AS next_appointment_type,
	min(IF ( a.location_id = l.location_id, a.class_next, NULL)) AS next_appointment_type_loc,
	min(IF ( na.next_appointment = a.date_next, a.location_id, NULL)) AS loc_next_appointment,
	p.is_active AS patient_is_active,
	p.first_treat AS first_treat,
	min(IF ( t.location_id = l.location_id, t.first_treat, NULL)) AS first_treat_loc,
	min(IF ( t.first_treat = p.first_treat, t.location_id, NULL)) AS loc_first_treat,
	na.date_prev AS prev_appointment,
	max(IF ( a.location_id = l.location_id, a.date_prev, NULL)) AS prev_appointment_loc,
	max(IF ( na.date_prev = a.date_prev, a.location_id, NULL)) AS loc_prev_appointment,
	na.date_prev_attended AS prev_appointment_attended,
	max(IF ( a.location_id = l.location_id, a.date_prev_attended, NULL)) AS prev_appointment_attended_loc,
	max(IF ( na.date_prev_attended = a.date_prev_attended, a.location_id, NULL)) AS loc_prev_appointment_attended,
	na.date_prev_attended_loc AS prev_appointment_loc_attended,
	max(IF ( a.location_id = l.location_id, a.date_prev_attended_loc, NULL)) AS prev_appointment_loc_attended_loc,
	max(IF ( na.date_prev_attended_loc = a.date_prev_attended_loc, a.location_id, NULL)) AS loc_prev_appointment_loc_attended,

	AND p.patient_id = a.patient_id

WITH 
Work_1_Prv AS 
(
SELECT
  a.dwh_client_id AS dwh_client_id,
  a.location_id as location_id,
  a.appt_date as date,
  toInt32(a.treat_providers_ids) AS provider_id,
  a.class_id AS appt_type_code,
  a.class_description AS appt_type,
  a.class_hidden AS appt_type_hidden,
  sum(a.appt_duration) AS work_minutes,
  count( distinct a.appoint_id) AS appointments,
  sum( if( a.items_treat_done_loc = 0, 0, a.appt_duration ) ) AS work_minutes_completed,
  count( distinct if( a.items_treat_done_loc = 0, NULL, a.appoint_id ) ) AS appointments_completed,
  count( distinct if( pa.rebooked_loc = 'Rebooked', a.appoint_id, NULL ) ) AS appointments_rebooked,
  count( distinct if( a.items_treat_done_loc > 0 AND pa.rebooked_loc = 'Rebooked', a.appoint_id, NULL ) ) AS appointments_completed_rebooked	
FROM {{ ref('appointments') }} a
JOIN {{ ref('patients_appointments') }} pa
  ON a.dwh_client_id = pa.dwh_client_id
  AND a.appoint_id = pa.appoint_id
WHERE
  date < today()
  AND a.items_treat_done_loc > 0
  AND a.treat_providers_count = 1
{% if client_id %}
  AND a.dwh_client_id = '{{ client_id | replace("'", "\\'") }}'
{% endif %}
GROUP BY
  dwh_client_id,
  location_id,
  provider_id,
  date,
  appt_type_code,
  appt_type,
  appt_type_hidden
),

Work_Some_Prv AS
(
SELECT 
  a.dwh_client_id AS dwh_client_id,
  a.location_id AS location_id,
  a.appt_date AS date,
  a.patient_id AS patient_id,
  count( distinct a.appoint_id) AS appointments,
  min(if( a.provider_location_id =  a.location_id, a.provider_id, if( a.book_provider_location_id=a.location_id, a.book_provider_id, null))) AS provider_id,
  max(if( a.provider_location_id =  a.location_id, a.provider_id, if( a.book_provider_location_id=a.location_id, a.book_provider_id, null))) AS max_provider_id,
  sum(a.appt_duration) AS work_minutes,
  sum( if( a.items_treat_done_loc = 0, 0, a.appt_duration ) ) AS work_minutes_completed,
  count( distinct if( a.items_treat_done_loc = 0, NULL, a.appoint_id ) ) AS appointments_completed,
  count( distinct if( pa.rebooked_loc = 'Rebooked', a.appoint_id, NULL ) ) AS appointments_rebooked,
  count( distinct if( a.items_treat_done_loc > 0 AND pa.rebooked_loc = 'Rebooked', a.appoint_id, NULL ) ) AS appointments_completed_rebooked	
FROM {{ ref('appointments') }} a
JOIN {{ ref('patients_appointments') }} pa
  ON a.dwh_client_id = pa.dwh_client_id
  AND a.appoint_id = pa.appoint_id
WHERE
  date < today()
  AND a.items_treat_done_loc > 0
  AND a.treat_providers_count > 1
{% if client_id %}
  AND a.dwh_client_id = '{{ client_id | replace("'", "\\'") }}'
{% endif %}
GROUP BY
		dwh_client_id,
		location_id,
		patient_id,
		date
),

Work_1_App_Prv AS
(
SELECT
  a.dwh_client_id AS dwh_client_id,
  a.location_id as location_id,
  a.appt_date as date,
  n.provider_id AS provider_id,
  a.class_id AS appt_type_code,
  a.class_description AS appt_type,
  a.class_hidden AS appt_type_hidden,
  count( distinct a.appoint_id) AS appointments,
  sum(a.appt_duration) AS work_minutes,
  sum( if( a.items_treat_done_loc = 0, 0, a.appt_duration ) ) AS work_minutes_completed,
  count( distinct if( a.items_treat_done_loc = 0, NULL, a.appoint_id ) ) AS appointments_completed,
  count( distinct if( pa.rebooked_loc = 'Rebooked', a.appoint_id, NULL ) ) AS appointments_rebooked,
  count( distinct if( a.items_treat_done_loc > 0 AND pa.rebooked_loc = 'Rebooked', a.appoint_id, NULL ) ) AS appointments_completed_rebooked	
FROM Work_Some_Prv n
JOIN {{ ref('appointments') }} a
  ON n.dwh_client_id = a.dwh_client_id
  AND n.location_id = a.location_id
  AND n.date = a.appt_date
  AND n.patient_id = a.patient_id
JOIN {{ ref('patients_appointments') }} pa
  ON a.dwh_client_id = pa.dwh_client_id
  AND a.appoint_id = pa.appoint_id
WHERE
  date < today()
  AND n.provider_id = n.max_provider_id
  AND n.provider_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  dwh_client_id,
  location_id,
  provider_id,
  date,
  appt_type_code,
  appt_type,
  appt_type_hidden
),

Work_Linked_App_Prvs AS
(
SELECT
  a.dwh_client_id AS dwh_client_id,
  a.location_id as location_id,
  a.appt_date as date,
  if( a.provider_location_id =  a.location_id, a.provider_id, if( a.book_provider_location_id=a.location_id, a.book_provider_id, null)) AS provider_id,
  a.class_id AS appt_type_code,
  a.class_description AS appt_type,
  a.class_hidden AS appt_type_hidden,
  count( distinct a.appoint_id) AS appointments,
  sum(a.appt_duration) AS work_minutes,
  sum( if( a.items_treat_done_loc = 0, 0, a.appt_duration ) ) AS work_minutes_completed,
  count( distinct if( a.items_treat_done_loc = 0, NULL, a.appoint_id ) ) AS appointments_completed,
  count( distinct if( pa.rebooked_loc = 'Rebooked', a.appoint_id, NULL ) ) AS appointments_rebooked,
  count( distinct if( a.items_treat_done_loc > 0 AND pa.rebooked_loc = 'Rebooked', a.appoint_id, NULL ) ) AS appointments_completed_rebooked	
FROM Work_Some_Prv n
JOIN {{ ref('appointments') }} a
  ON n.dwh_client_id = a.dwh_client_id
  AND n.location_id = a.location_id
  AND n.date = a.appt_date
  AND n.patient_id = a.patient_id
JOIN {{ ref('patients_appointments') }} pa
  ON a.dwh_client_id = pa.dwh_client_id
  AND a.appoint_id = pa.appoint_id
WHERE
  date < today()
  AND n.provider_id <> n.max_provider_id
  AND n.provider_id IS NOT NULL
  AND a.items_treat_done_loc > 0
  AND a.treat_providers_count > 1
  AND countSubstrings(concat(',',a.treat_providers_ids,','), concat(',', toString(provider_id), ',')) > 0
GROUP BY
  dwh_client_id,
  location_id,
  provider_id,
  date,
  appt_type_code,
  appt_type,
  appt_type_hidden
)

SELECT
  w.dwh_client_id as dwh_client_id,
  w.location_id as location_id,
  w.date as date,
  w.provider_id as provider_id,
  p.provider_is_active as provider_is_active,

SELECT
	t.dwh_client_id AS dwh_client_id,
	t.date AS date,
	t.payment_type AS payment_type,
	t.ref_status AS ref_status,
	IF (left(PPA_status,1) = '0', date, coalesce(toDate32(t.when_created),t.date_created_2,t.date)) AS date_effective,
	toDate32(t.when_deleted) AS date_reversed,
	coalesce(t.lock_date_creation,makeDate32(1900,1,1)) AS lock_date_creation,
	coalesce(t.lock_date_deletion,makeDate32(1900,1,1)) AS lock_date_deletion,
	-- Payment PPA status
	CASE
		WHEN gs.param_value <> '1' THEN '00' 
		WHEN ref_status IS NULL AND lock_date_creation < date THEN '00'
		WHEN ref_status IS NULL THEN '10'
		WHEN lock_date_creation >= date AND lock_date_deletion >= date THEN '11'
		WHEN lock_date_deletion >= date THEN '01'
		ELSE '00'
	END AS PPA_status,
	-- Locatons
	t.practice_id AS location_payment,
	t.tot_paym_amount AS amount_receipt,
	p.amount AS amount_payment,
	-- IDs
	t.tot_paym_id AS ID_receipt,
	p.id AS ID_payment,
	p.deposit_tot_payment_id_from AS ID_deposit_from,
	t.discount_category_id AS ID_discount_category,
	-- Payer
	t.paid_by_patient AS payer_patient_id,
	t.paid_by_third payer_third_party_id,
	third.thp_type AS payer_third_party_type,
	-- Method of Payment
	p.method_of_paym_id AS method_id,
	m.description AS method_name,
	m.group_type AS method_group_type,
	m.show_in_report AS method_show_in_report,
	m.code_sys AS code_sys
FROM 
	{{ source('staging_layer', 'payments_dedup') }} p
	JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'tot_payment_dedup') }} t ON t.dwh_client_id = p.dwh_client_id AND t.tot_paym_id = p.tot_paym_id
	JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'methods_of_paym_dedup') }} m ON t.dwh_client_id = m.dwh_client_id AND p.method_of_paym_id = m.method_of_paym_id
	JOIN {{ ref('general_settings') }} gs ON t.dwh_client_id = gs.dwh_client_id AND gs.param_code = '@ADJUSTMENTS_USED'
	LEFT JOIN {{ source('staging_layer', 'third_parties_dedup') }} third ON t.dwh_client_id = third.dwh_client_id AND t.paid_by_third = third.third_party_id 
WHERE
  least(date,date_effective,date_reversed) < today()
  AND (gs.param_value = '1' OR t.ref_status IS NULL)
  AND (t.ref_status IS NULL OR PPA_status <> '00')
{% if client_id %}

    with snapshot_time as (
        select {{ strategy.updated_at }} as ts  -- Single timestamp
    ),
        snapshot_query as (

        {{ source_sql }}

    ),

    snapshotted_data as (

        select *,
            {{ strategy.unique_key }} as dbt_unique_key

        from {{ target_relation }}
        where dbt_valid_to is null

    ),

    insertions_source_data as (

        select
            *,
            {{ strategy.unique_key }} as dbt_unique_key,
            snapshot_time.ts as dbt_updated_at,
            snapshot_time.ts as dbt_valid_from,
            nullif(snapshot_time.ts, snapshot_time.ts) as dbt_valid_to,
            {{ strategy.scd_id }} as dbt_scd_id

        from snapshot_query, snapshot_time
    ),

    updates_source_data as (

        select
            *,
            {{ strategy.unique_key }} as dbt_unique_key,
            snapshot_time.ts as dbt_updated_at,
            snapshot_time.ts as dbt_valid_from,
            snapshot_time.ts as dbt_valid_to

        from snapshot_query, snapshot_time
    ),

    {%- if strategy.invalidate_hard_deletes %}

    deletes_source_data as (

        select
            *,
            {{ strategy.unique_key }} as dbt_unique_key
        from snapshot_query
    ),
    {% endif %}

    insertions as (

        select
            'insert' as dbt_change_type,
            source_data.*

        from insertions_source_data as source_data
        left outer join snapshotted_data on snapshotted_data.dbt_unique_key = source_data.dbt_unique_key
        where snapshotted_data.dbt_unique_key is null
           or (
                snapshotted_data.dbt_unique_key is not null
            and (
                {{ strategy.row_changed }}
            )
        )

    ),

    updates as (

        select
            'update' as dbt_change_type,
            source_data.*,
            snapshotted_data.dbt_scd_id

        from updates_source_data as source_data
        join snapshotted_data on snapshotted_data.dbt_unique_key = source_data.dbt_unique_key
        where (
            {{ strategy.row_changed }}
        )
    )

    {%- if strategy.invalidate_hard_deletes -%}
    ,

    deletes as (

        select
            'delete' as dbt_change_type,
            source_data.*,
            {{ snapshot_get_time() }} as dbt_valid_from,
            {{ snapshot_get_time() }} as dbt_updated_at,
            {{ snapshot_get_time() }} as dbt_valid_to,
            snapshotted_data.dbt_scd_id

        from snapshotted_data
        left join deletes_source_data as source_data on snapshotted_data.dbt_unique_key = source_data.dbt_unique_key
        where source_data.dbt_unique_key is null
    )
    {%- endif %}

    select * EXCEPT (ts) from insertions
    union all
    select * EXCEPT (ts) from updates
    {%- if strategy.invalidate_hard_deletes %}
    union all
    select * EXCEPT (ts) from deletes
    {%- endif %}

{%- endmacro %}

### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models
in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the
models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view
shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown
in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand`
button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build,
or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the
models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.
